reason: The report's 'no effect' rests on an unjustified restriction to the north region (N=634). With the same controls, the full sample (N=2000) gives 0.69 (SE 0.24, p=0.004), and the south subsample is also significant (1.11, p=0.01). The north estimate is just an imprecise, positive coefficient, so a null conclusion isn't supported. The report also says only one specification was estimated and doesn't disclose that the subgroup choice drives the result.
